system.notes:
In places of death and decay, the ageless creatures of the dark sometimes merge into symbiotic beings neither dead nor alive. Oozes that absorb too much necrotic matter are most prone to this baleful transformation, becoming slush-like zombies called zomblobs! These profane slimes infest tombs and catacombs. They are exceptionally hard to eradicate thanks to their formless, undead nature and regenerative ability. A sickly purple carpet of rolling sludge. Eyeballs, organs, and partially dissolved bones bubble up before being reabsorbed.

AC 10, HP 14, ATK 2 clawed tentacle +3 (1d6), MV near (climb), S +2, D +0, C +1, I -4, W -3, Ch +1, AL C, LV 3

Undead. Immune to morale checks.

Endless Guts. If at 1 HP or higher, regain 1d4 HP at start of turn.

Relentless. If zomblob is reduced to 0 HP by a non-magical source, DC 9 CON to go to 1 HP instead.

Art by Yuri Perkowski-Domingos, 2023
